title: RAW UNREVIEWED: growing-record shortest-prefix references lengthen when new written competitors appear
summary: A complete modern source-preserving hand rule builds its word inventory from full words already read in the current record. An already known word uses its shortest uniquely distinguishing proper prefix only when the paid reference is strictly shorter than full spelling. New prefix-sharing words can retire or lengthen an earlier abbreviation. The declared20-payload+escape+prefix-reference carrier is retained unchanged although root reported1293's conditional exclusive-initial-marker contradiction before this final file was written. The broader algorithm is not thereby tested.

design.purpose: Avoid rewriting a fully supplied long word when a short visible beginning already identifies it in the local text. A new similar word makes additional letters necessary, instead of silently choosing an intended referent. Meaning is carried by the exactly recovered original wording, not by a private native glossary.

physical_carrier.literal_language: A literal body is a nonempty concatenation of one-sign A..T codes or three-sign V,payload,payload codes. This fixed code is prefix-free and no literal body contains U.

inventory.initial: D is empty at each visibly supplied record start.
inventory.contents: D is a SET of complete exact source word strings already decoded in this record. Distinct occurrences of the same exact word do not create different entries. Case and punctuation are part of identity.
inventory.admission: After a full literal word is decoded, add it to D if absent. References resolve to an existing member and do not add their short prefix as a new word.
inventory.persistence: No eviction, moving window, reordering, semantic merging, revised historical reading or hidden reset occurs before the next record.
inventory.cost: The entire growing list must be remembered or consulted in the preceding written record. There is no finite slot cap or fixed numeric address, but this does not make memory and lookup free.

writing_rule: Take D as it exists BEFORE the current source word w.
If w is absent from D, emit its entire literal encoding L(w). Only after writing it add w to D.
If w is already in D, inspect its nonempty PROPER prefixes in increasing source-character length. A prefix p distinguishes w exactly when w is the sole member of D beginning with p.
Let p be the first such prefix, if any. There is no tie at a given length because w has only one prefix of that length. Empty prefixes and the complete word are never reference bodies.
If p exists AND 1+length(L(p)) < length(L(w)), emit U followed by L(p). Use this abbreviation obligatorily. The extra1is the actual reference drawing.
Otherwise emit the full L(w), even though w is already known. Equal cost is a mandatory full literal spelling, not a discretionary alias.
Write the supplied word gap. Keep D across ordinary word gaps and physical line wraps. Clear D only at the supplied visible record boundary.
reading_rule: First reconstruct logical groups from the physical layout rule below. Begin a record with D empty.
If a logical group begins with U, remove that first U and decode the remaining nonempty literal body p using the fixed character code. Reject any other U in that body.

Require exactly one word w in D beginning with p. Require p to be a proper prefix of w, the shortest distinguishing nonempty proper prefix under current D, and strictly cheaper after counting U. Otherwise reject.
Output w exactly. Do not add p to D or reinterpret earlier references when D later grows.
A group not beginning with U must be a nonempty valid literal body L(w). Decode it exactly.
If w was already known and a mandatory strictly cheaper reference exists under current D, reject this noncanonical literal spelling. Otherwise output w and add it if absent.

A complete record ends only after a complete source word. Forward induction proves exact recovery: every first use supplies its complete spelling; every reference has exactly one already recovered expansion.

prefix_collision_cases.shorter_word_prefixes_longer: With D={art,artist}, no proper prefix of art distinguishes art, so art remains literal. For artist, arti is the shortest distinguishing prefix. No unprinted end-of-word symbol or assumed lexical choice is added.
prefix_collision_cases.short_repetition: With D containing do, its only proper prefix d costs1payload plus U, exactly the same as literal DO. Thus repeated do stays literal. A one-character word has no nonempty proper prefix and always remains literal.
prefix_collision_cases.identical_references: Once a valid reference has been used, an immediate repetition of the same source word leaves D unchanged and repeats that reference exactly. Arbitrarily long repeated reference groups are possible. No copied group is silently removed.
prefix_collision_cases.new_competitor: An old reference may become illegal AFTER another complete literal word sharing its prefix is introduced. Earlier references retain the expansions licensed at their own reading time; no retrospective reinterpretation is permitted.
prefix_collision_cases.canonicality: Choosing a longer prefix when a shorter saving prefix was legal, or retaining an old ambiguous prefix after a competitor, is not a second spelling option.

hand_examples.readback: The second word refers uniquely to previously spelled amber by a. After literal amble, amber needs ambe to distinguish it; U+AMBE costs5, tying full AMBER at5. The final word is therefore obligatorily full AMBER. This preserves the actual source wording and demonstrates competitor-driven lengthening.

hand_examples.source: do not boil. do not boil.
hand_examples.readback: First spell do, not, boil. in full; the period is rare index20, so its code is V,B,A. Repeated do remains literal by the tie rule. UN expands to not; UB expands to the complete previously written boil., including its period. Both negative instructions are recovered, in order.
Uppercase A is rare index32, encoded V,B,M. Full Ada costs5signs; reference to its uppercase first character costs4including U and is valid. The exact case is preserved.
hand_examples.scope: A finite source-name example, not a claim that any name is present in the manuscript.

physical_layout.gaps: One visible gap separates logical source words. A visibly empty line separates records and clears D. A single ordinary physical line break is a word boundary unless marked as continuation. These are explicit layout conventions, not identified manuscript paragraph semantics.
physical_layout.continuation: UU appended at the end of a nonfinal physical line means its nonempty word fragment continues on the immediately next nonblank line. Strip exactly those last two U signs and concatenate the next fragment without a source word gap. D is not updated until the complete logical word is decoded.
physical_layout.no_marker_collision: UU cannot occur in an unbroken logical encoding: U is allowed only once, at the beginning of a reference, and its nonempty literal body contains no U. A fragment ending in its original leading U will therefore display UUU after continuation is appended; remove exactly the final pair, not every trailing pair.
physical_layout.packet_splitting: A physical split may fall inside a pending V packet because continuation removal happens before literal parsing. Every fragment must contain at least one original sign; do not insert empty continuation lines.
physical_layout.cost: Every continued-word break adds2signs and one further physical fragment. No fixed raster or width is asserted. The writing area must fit a nonempty fragment plus its marker; whole words may instead be moved to a new line.
physical_layout.scope: Logical spelling is canonical; discretionary layout is not claimed unique. Physical fragments must not silently replace logical words in any frequency invariant.

new_consequences.monotonic_length: For a fixed already admitted w, D only grows, so a once ambiguous prefix never becomes unique later in that record. The minimum distinguishing prefix length cannot decrease. Because every character code is nonempty, its encoded length also cannot decrease. Strict saving followed by literal fallback caps output at fixed length(L(w)). Hence from the SECOND occurrence of w onward, its canonical logical spelling length is nondecreasing until reset. The first full introduction may of course be followed by a shorter second occurrence.
new_consequences.prefix_retirement: If U+L(p) has referred to w, and a different complete word v beginning with p is subsequently introduced, U+L(p) cannot recur anywhere later in that record. It is now ambiguous and D never forgets v.
new_consequences.unchanged_context: If no new competitor sharing the previous distinguishing prefix has entered D, a repeated source word keeps the same reference. Mere distance, use count, grammatical role or picture position does not change its code.
new_consequences.source_bound_falsifier: Under an independently fixed literal key, R/E roles and record boundaries, a short reference used after its written competing full word has entered D, or a later shortening after the second occurrence without reset, contradicts the fixed algorithm. A prefix match alone does not identify meaning or establish the key.
new_consequences.not_a_synonym_claim: The comparison concerns exact source word strings and recoverable orthographic references. It does not assume two different native whole forms have the same meaning or that later mentions are generally semantically anaphoric.
new_consequences.finite_form_bound: For a source word of ncharacters, there are at most n global logical spellings under this contract: its full literal form and at most n-1proper-prefix references. Strict saving may leave far fewer. Different records can reuse one short reference for different full words; message-level inversion remains unique.
new_consequences.not_old_frequency_invariance: This is not a fixed one-source-word/one-written-form mapping or automatically an at-most-two-alias system. No statistics or favourable outcome is claimed. Its own finite prefix, introduction and memory costs remain measurable obligations.

costs.compression: Only references that strictly save output signs are used. This does not prove net saving relative to ordinary plaintext, since rare characters expand to3signs and physical continuation adds signs.
